FMVMode.description: Original fits the whole movie inside a 4:3 frame; Fit uses the screen. Both preserve the full picture.
plugin.name: Just Cause Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Use 0 for the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
ResY.description: Use 0 for the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos. Needs a restart.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the native fix menu language. Auto uses a supported detected language, or English when detection or translation is unavailable. Reopen Advanced Options to apply.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places side-anchored HUD groups at the screen edges. Choose a ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 to keep them inside a centered box. Text and icons keep their proportions.
MAIN.WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a bordered window or borderless fullscreen. The bordered window keeps the selected resolution as its client size. Requires a restart.
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pauses the game while another window is active.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Limit rendered frames per second. 0 is Unlimited; Monitor follows the active display refresh rate. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
CutsceneBorders.description: Letterbox keeps the game's bars above and below cutscenes; Pillarbox keeps the picture at 4:3 between side bars on wider screens; Both does both and shows the original framing; Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the original framing; larger values widen the view, up to 150 degrees across. Cutscenes keep their framing. Applies immediately.
